Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for contacting Insperity Time & Attendance Support. We have provided two links for your reference. The first link will walk you through the process of adding IP addresses, and the second link will assist you with finding your IP address.
Managing IP Restrictions (https://help.insperity.com/bps/knowledge-base/ip-address-restrictions-for-time-and-attendance/)
Finding your IP Address (https://timestar.insperity.com/Hermes/api/IpAddress)
Note: There may be 2 addresses listed. We are specifically looking for the <xff> address.
If you have additional questions or concerns, please let us know and we will be happy to help.
Thank you,
